title: About Me

Computer Administrator · Hardware & Networking · Technical Trainer

Hello! I'm Menelik Admasu, a Computer Science student at Bahir Dar University with a passion for building clean, functional software and exploring modern web technologies.

If you're looking for a multitasking, detail-oriented computer administrator who can keep things running smoothly, I'm also the right person for that role. My experience as computer staff, strong administrative skills, and extensive professional experience mean you can rely on me to handle responsibilities effectively and efficiently.

My goal is to continue growing as a developer while building meaningful and useful technology. I enjoy turning ideas into interactive experiences — from classic desktop UIs to polished mobile layouts. This portfolio itself is a playful tribute to Windows XP and the iPhone Pro Max.

Interests

  • Full-stack web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript & beyond)
  • UI/UX design and nostalgic interfaces
  • Computer networking & maintenance
  • Problem-solving and algorithms
  • Open-source contributions
  • Attraction to new things · Computer coding · Reading books · Doing new things
